meta.name: Esports Destiny Match scoring configuration
meta.note: Transparent, editable weights for the layered BaZi compatibility model. The local engine computes the ranking and percentages from these values. Nothing here is random.
meta.calibration: Four Pillars (year/month/day + optional hour), day-master strength (simplified 扶抑), 喜用神 favorable elements, the Li Chun zodiac boundary and lunar-mansion anchors are calibrated for a lightweight, entertainment-first experience — not for ephemeris-accurate BaZi.
meta.model_note: Each layer returns a 0..1 score; layer weights below sum to 1.0. If either side lacks a reliable birth hour, the birthHour weight is redistributed proportionally across the first three layers (never deducted).

coreBazi.sub_note: Four Pillars core. `favorable` = 喜用神 alignment (how much the player's chart carries the user's favorable elements) and is the largest single component of the whole score. `dayMaster` = day-master Ten-God relation, `balance` = combined five-element evenness, `combine` = 天干五合 day-stem bond. These four sum to 1.0 within the 55% core layer.
